note: Who speaks in which voice (ADR-0019, SND-018). Voices are Kokoro v1.0 voices (docs/licenses/kokoro-tts.md), voiced offline by Tools/voice/make_dialogue_voices.py into Prototype/play/audio/voices/. Each role has a pool; a resident takes one by a fixed hash of their id, so they always sound the same. 'pick' marks the owner's choice from the cast samples (2026-11-22); the rest were added for variety (owner chose 'a few voices per role') and can be swapped. shift raises (above 1) or lowers (below 1) pitch and voice size together; speed is the pace. Moods are the level the owner chose (2026-11-22). 'people' (ADR-0060) gives a named resident a voice of their own, by resident id, used instead of their role's pool: { "name": the resident's name (checked against the residents, so a town dealt again cannot hand the voice to someone else), "voice", "lang", and if wanted "shift" and "speed" }; "voice" may be two voices in a list, mixed evenly, and "lang" is then the accent of one of them. An entry { "name", "cast": <id> } instead gives the resident the voice of a named character of the cast (Tools/voice/cast/cast_voices.json), whose lines are made by the cast recipe and not by Kokoro; such a resident speaks only the lines that have been voiced for them. "model": "maya1" marks a part voiced by Maya1 (ADR-0063, Tools/voice/cast/import_maya_clips.py) instead of the cast recipe; "partial" says what of the part is not voiced yet (those lines are murmured). Only the owner fills this list, by saying so in chat. 'roles_not_voiced' are roles added after the cast was chosen that have no pool yet: their residents are not voiced (wordless syllables, as any line with no voice) until the owner picks a pool for them.
